title: Page builder
hint: Draw a page of the site. It lives among the generic pages of the “Page builder” layout and is viewed without the site menu or footer, at /[langue]/p/[identifiant]. The storefront components that already exist stay in the palette, next to the kit blocks (gallery, carousel, slider, flyer, calls to action).
backToList: Back to the generic pages list
saveError: Could not save: check your rights or the API connection.
loadError: The record could not be loaded.
listError: The page list could not be loaded.
createNeeded: A URL identifier and a title are required.
createError: The page could not be created.
componentsHint: Double-click in the canvas to write. The classes listed under a block are its settings: reuse them in the style panel.
templateConfirm: The starting point replaces the page content. Continue?
noPageTitle: No page of the builder type
noPageText: Create one, or switch an existing generic page to the “Page builder” layout from the pages list: it will show up here.
